verses.1: And it happened that when Sanbalat, Tobiah, Geser, and the rest of our people heard about this, I built the house. But there was no one who could enter it at that time. The doors were not even opened at all.
verses.2: And Samballat and Geshem were sent to me with the words, “Go and attack them together in the wilderness of Oman. They plan to do me harm.”
verses.3: And I will send servants after them, saying, “I will do a great work. I will not be able to descend and carry out this task.” But I will come down to you when the time comes.
verses.4: And they sent me these words four times. I answered them with those very same words.
verses.5: And he sent to me Sanbalat with these words. For the fifth time, he brought with him a young man and a key in his hand.
verses.6: It is written in the scriptures that in those lands, words will be heard and deeds will be fulfilled. You say, “You and the Jews think to be honored by others.” Therefore, you build up this world, and you become their king, according to these words.
verses.7: And also, prophets stood before you in Jerusalem to say, “King of Judah, now listen to these words.” Now, let the king hear these words. And now, let us make a plan together.
verses.8: And I sent him, saying, “These things shall not happen. You are only speaking these words out of your own heart.”
verses.9: For they all look at us and say, “Let them lay down their hands from this work.” But now, strengthen my hands.
verses.10: And I came to Shemaiah’s house. He was the son of Delaya, and he was the son of Mehitabael. He said, “I will go to the temple of God, into the inner chamber. The doors of the temple will be closed, for those who come to kill you will do so during the day.”
verses.11: And she said, “A man like me will flee. But who can come into the house like me? I will never go in.”
verses.12: And I knew that it was not God who sent him. For the message he brought was good and beneficial. His reward was great.
verses.13: So that his reward would be for the sake of Israel. And so it was done. But I sinned, and it became a curse upon them, so that they could be punished.
verses.14: God remembered Tovia and Sambalat, because of their actions. He also remembered Noadya, the prophetess, and all those prophets who feared me.
verses.15: And the month was completed on the twenty-third day of Elul, which was fifty-two days after the start of the month.
verses.16: And when all our enemies heard this, and when all the nations around us saw this, they fell down in fear. They realized that from our God this terrible thing had been done.
verses.17: Also in those days, many of the Jews’ livestock wandered onto the land of Tovya. And those who lived in Tovya came to them.
verses.18: For many in Judah are like those who are led astray. For he is the son of Arah, and Yehohanan is his son. He took away the daughter of Mesulam, the son of Berechiah.
verses.19: Even his good things were spoken about before me. My words provided him with excuses. The good man sent Toviyah to my house.
